description: The canonical client authorization: ComputeBudget limit then price, the 14-account open (payee and rent payer the fee payer, authorized signer the receiver authorizer, 100% to payTo), a hex nonce memo; payload bound to the open, deposit == maxAmount == amount, validAfter <= now < expiresAt <= now + maxTimeoutSeconds. Verify is the read-only preflight of the deposit settle (Phase 3): every static check before co-signing, at the vector's clock (nowSeconds).

spec.quote: If two requirements-bound roles intentionally have the same address (for example feePayer == receiverAuthorizer), each occurrence in its prescribed open position is permitted.

description: payTo equals extra.feePayer and the open still carries the explicit single-entry [{ payTo, 10000 }] distribution. Verify is the read-only preflight of the deposit settle (Phase 3): every static check before co-signing, at the vector's clock (nowSeconds).
